reviews.name: Jocelyn Rineer
reviews.text: We lost the keys to our front door. I called and they changed out the locks & hardware and all of this was done within 45 minutes. Gary was the locksmith and he was friendly and did a great job! Their pricing was reasonable. I highly recommend them.

reviews.name: Kelly Villarin
reviews.text: Gary did a great job installing our smart lock and explaining its different features. He was very professional and answered all of my questions. He also installed my Blink camera free of charge

reviews.name: Sw an
reviews.text: The locksmith was very efficient, quick and very knowledgeable. Saved a lot of time and money versus getting 2019 Infiniti’s replacement key fob programmed at the dealership.

reviews.name: Viviana Kesel
reviews.text: The tech was very courteous and helpful. He did a very good job programming key fobs for my car in reasonable amount of time.

reviews.name: Brittney Haas
reviews.text: Yarin was very responsive, communicated well, and helped me into my apartment quickly

reviews.name: Rabecca K
reviews.text: I needed to switch out a deadbolt. It was requested that they come the same day which they did. I am happy with their service.

reviews.name: Jim Carlson
reviews.text: The locksmith was very helpful and right on time and would use them again.

reviews.name: Patrick Reilly
reviews.text: They arrived in a very timely manner and did a nice quick job.

reviews.name: Charles Evans
reviews.text: Quick and professional very nice and good at hisjob

reviews.name: Aized H Mir
reviews.text: Very professional and quick. Great price too.
